title: Graph Processing Core
summary: This module defines the core components for building, running, and managing directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) or state machines. It includes nodes, graph execution, state persistence, and tools for path construction and parallel processing.

nodes.label: Define Node Behavior
nodes.title: BaseNode
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all nodes in the graph, defining the fundamental `run` method that dictates node execution and the possible next steps or termination of the graph.

nodes.label: Define Graph Structure
nodes.title: Graph
nodes.description: Represents the overall graph structure, composed of various nodes. It provides methods for running the graph, iterating through its execution, and generating visual diagrams.

nodes.label: Execute Graph
nodes.title: GraphRun
nodes.description: Manages the stateful execution of a graph, allowing for step-by-step iteration through nodes, access to the current state, and manual control over the graph's flow.

nodes.label: Capture Run Result
nodes.title: GraphRunResult
nodes.description: Holds the final output and the end state of a graph after its execution has completed, providing a comprehensive summary of the run.

nodes.label: Synchronize Parallel Paths
nodes.title: Join
nodes.description: Defines how to combine outputs from multiple parallel execution paths using a reducer function, managing synchronization and aggregation of results.

nodes.label: Identify Parent Forks
nodes.title: ParentForkFinder
nodes.description: Analyzes the graph's structure to identify dominating forks for join nodes, ensuring proper coordination of parallel execution and preventing deadlocks.

nodes.label: Construct Execution Paths
nodes.title: PathBuilder
nodes.description: Offers a fluent API for building complex execution paths within the graph, supporting operations like transformations, mapping, and routing to destinations.

nodes.label: Abstract State Persistence
nodes.title: BaseStatePersistence
nodes.description: An abstract interface for defining how the state of a graph run is stored and retrieved, enabling durable and resumable graph executions.

nodes.label: Persist State to File
nodes.title: FileStatePersistence
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of state persistence that stores graph run snapshots in a JSON file, allowing for recovery and inspection of past runs.

nodes.label: Persist State In-Memory
nodes.title: FullStatePersistence
nodes.description: An in-memory implementation of state persistence that stores a complete history of graph snapshots, with an option for deep copying state to ensure immutability.

nodes.label: Define Graph Step
nodes.title: Step
nodes.description: Represents a single, atomic unit of execution within the graph, encapsulating a step function and associated metadata like ID and an optional label.

groups.label: Graph Definition
groups.title: Graph Definition
groups.description: Components for defining the structure and individual units of a graph.

groups.label: Graph Execution
groups.title: Graph Execution
groups.description: Components responsible for running the graph and capturing its outcomes.

groups.label: State Persistence
groups.title: State Persistence
groups.description: Mechanisms for storing and retrieving the graph's state for durability and recovery.

groups.label: Parallel Processing Utilities
groups.title: Parallel Processing Utilities
groups.description: Tools for analyzing graph structure to support parallel execution and synchronization.
